sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (frozen 2026-11-18). Guide text is written for this entry, in our own words, from the official descriptions — never copied from another guide. Where the official description does not pin down a place or step, the guide says so.

trophies.guide: Think of this as the game's way of saying 'done': you cannot chase it directly, because it only appears when your checklist reads 54 of 54 for everything else. The practical move is to watch the progress bar at the top of this guide — when a single trophy remains, that last one is the platinum's real requirement. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up (1 platinum of 55).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the story mission called Gone Fishing through to its end. It is a main-mission trophy, so there is nothing to unlock or prepare beforehand — keep following the story markers in order and it will come to you. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. No grinding is needed: chapter trophies are pure story progress, earned by playing the missions in the order the game gives them. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies, it cannot be missed — it is story progress, not a side task — so just keep playing the main missions in order. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Nothing here needs doing outside the story: follow the mission markers and the chapter will end on its own. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and like the rest it is unmissable story progress. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: This gold is the story's closing beat: finish the last mission and it unlocks as the credits roll. It is one of only two golds, and it asks for nothing beyond the mission itself — but use the calm before the finale well. Clear the missables in this guide first, since a few one-shot trophies belong to moments the story does not revisit. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play the story mission called Breakfast Run through to its end. Named-mission trophies like this one are unmissable: the mission appears as you follow the story, and finishing it is all it takes. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Play the story mission called The Cartel Heist through to its end. Heist missions are main-story beats, so this one arrives by playing the story in order — no preparation or side task unlocks it. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play the story mission called Child's Play through to its end. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by following the main missions in order — nothing outside the story is needed. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Play the story mission called Headliners through to its end. As with the other named-mission trophies, finishing the mission is the whole requirement — keep to the story path and it will pop. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Play the story mission called VCIA Takedown through to its end. It is a main-story mission at the airport, and finishing it is all the trophy asks — no side errand feeds into it. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Play the story mission called Operation Savage Glory through to its end. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by following the main missions in order — nothing outside the story is needed. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own checklist — story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the rest, all finished. This is the last big gate before the platinum: when the in-game completion counter hits 100%, this gold pops, and the platinum follows with it. Check the in-game stats page to see which category is still short. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, flips and airtime tricks while driving or riding, tracked by the game. This is a long grind, so fold it into everything else: take ramps and jumps whenever you travel instead of driving straight, and the count will climb across the whole playthrough. PSN tracks the total at 250. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 250 target.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once — the game counts 9 types, and one taste of each is enough. Work through the activity icons on the map one by one in a single free-roam session: fishing, racing, the shooting range, bowling, darts and the rest, until the last type registers. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the activity count.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them, per PSNProfiles — which means accuracy and speed, not just finishing. Take them one weapon class at a time, learn each challenge's target pattern before rushing it, and replay the ones that land silver until they turn gold. The range tracks your best medal per challenge, so you can improve them across sessions. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 42-challenge count.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.target: 42 Shooting Range challenges, gold in each

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of its locations around Leonida. Drone racing is about smooth lines, not top speed: cut corners tight, avoid clipping obstacles that kill your momentum, and learn a course with one slow lap before racing it for the win. The official description does not give the number of locations, so visit every Top Fun marker on the map. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.target: a win at every drone race location

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so repeating the same one does not help. Work through the race markers across the map, varying vehicle classes as you go, and keep an eye on the race list so you do not re-run one you have already won. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest, not free fishing. The official description does not pin down where or when Cal's challenge triggers, so look for the fishing challenge marker and take it when it appears; bring your best rod and keep tension steady rather than reeling hard. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game — start it, play it through, and see its end screen. Any arcade cabinet counts, so pick the game you find easiest and play that one to completion rather than sampling several. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand: play each of his missions in order until the last one, and the trophy pops when that final mission ends. Stranger strands unlock as you explore and meet people, so if Andy has not appeared yet, keep playing the story and checking the stranger markers on the map. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand: play each of his missions in order until the last one, and the trophy pops when that final mission ends. Like the other stranger strands, his missions appear over time — work them as they show up rather than hunting for them all at once. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand: play each of his missions in order until the last one, and the trophy pops when that final mission ends. The official description does not pin down where Billy's strand starts, so follow the stranger markers and take his missions when they appear. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest each count as one strand when their final mission is done. This is the umbrella trophy over the side strands: finish strands as you meet their people, and it pops with the eighth. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand: play each of his missions in order until the last one, and the trophy pops when that final mission ends. Work stranger missions as they appear on the map — they stack up toward the 8-strand silver as well. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand: play each of his missions in order until the last one, and the trophy pops when that final mission ends. The official description does not pin down where Tyrone's strand starts, so take his missions as the stranger markers appear. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — sit, breathe, and let the session complete at each one. Spots are scattered across the map, so clear them region by region and tick them off as you go; the official description does not give the total number, so keep going until every spot you find has been used. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt one unique animal for Bret — a specific creature tied to his strand, not any animal in the wild. Follow Bret's missions until he names the animal, then track it: approach downwind, move slowly, and take a clean shot rather than spooking it. The official description does not pin down which animal or where it lives, so let Bret's strand lead you to it. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets — find the cards scattered around Leonida and fill three sets to the last card. Cards are a long hunt, so pick up every card you pass while doing other things instead of saving them all for the end, and use the in-game collection view to see which sets are one or two cards short. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is a volume trophy, so make it a habit: WAiNK It at every new place you visit while exploring, rather than grinding it in one sitting. The game tracks distinct locations, so repeats at the same spot do not count. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 100-location target.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's own challenge list, from driving feats to combat and exploration goals. Challenges tick over naturally as you play, so check the challenge menu now and then and chase the near-complete ones; 50 is a count, not a specific set, so pick the easiest half of the list. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape clean. Missable — do it on purpose: pick a quiet area with good escape routes, let the wanted stars climb to 4 with your partner present, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. If your partner is lost or the stars drop early, reset and try again. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Plan the route before the first robbery, because the whole trophy is one unbroken chain. Missable: with your partner alongside, rob a shop, then move straight to a second and a third nearby shop while the cops are still chasing you — the wanted stars must stay alive across all three. If the heat dies between shops, the chain is gone and you begin again from shop one. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Treat the vehicle list as a checklist: every model you have never sat in is a point waiting to be taken. While exploring, hop into parked cars, bikes and boats you would normally walk past — each new model adds one, and 100 of them earns the trophy. Your usual favourite car adds nothing after the first time, so curiosity pays here. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 100-vehicle target.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus — five kills before the focus meter runs out. Missable in the sense that the set-up matters: find a spot with at least five enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus with a full meter, and chain the kills fast without wasting time aiming between them. If you run out of targets mid-focus, reset and try a busier fight. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport — which means leaving in a plane without going through the normal route. Missable: this is a one-shot stunt at the airport, so go in with a plan (a fast vehicle or an aircraft on the tarmac), keep the cops off you long enough to get airborne, and do not dawdle on the runway. The official description does not pin down the exact trigger, so expect some trial and error. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction — it does not say what to do with a Rhino tank, and neither do the public lists yet. The sensible read is that it involves the Rhino tank itself: find one, drive it, and see what the game counts — likely surviving heat or causing mayhem in it. Treat this as unconfirmed: try the obvious tank play, and check the in-game stats or trophy progress to see what moved. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out without ever being detected — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Missable: plan it like a stealth job. Go in quiet, move when staff look away, take the goods without smashing displays in sight, and leave before anyone notices. If you are spotted, the attempt is blown — leave, reset, and try again clean. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one — five successful vault jobs with a clean getaway every time. Banks are the heavy jobs: bring a fast escape vehicle, plan the route out before you go in, and do not linger once the vault is open. Each vault counts separately, so you can spread them across the playthrough. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 5-vault target.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — stop one, crack it open, take the cash, and get away clean. Armored trucks roam the roads, so watch for one, block it in a quiet stretch, and have a fast getaway car ready before you start: the robbery itself is quick, the escape is the hard part. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every one of the 52 areas PSNProfiles tracks, so the whole map counts as seen. The practical way is to sweep the map region by region, driving every road and checking the area name as it changes on screen; the in-game map and stats show which areas are still unvisited. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 52-area target.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — one hit per gang, not several hits on the same one. Find the gangs' operations across the map, rob one for every gang, and keep a note of which gangs you have done so none is missed. The official description does not name the gangs or their spots, so use the map markers and your own notes. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order and enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Missable — it is tied to being at the beach at the right moment, so do it while you are there during the story rather than assuming it will wait: find a beachfront spot serving drinks, sit with the view, and take the cocktail. If you leave the beach without doing it, you may need another visit. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Pick the car before the showroom: you want something fast with a straight run at the glass. Missable — drive in, line up with the front window, and go straight through in one committed burst; a half-hearted attempt leaves you beached inside the showroom. The official description names no particular showroom, so any vehicle showroom is the honest first try, and another one if the first does not pop. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a full game there. The official description does not spell out the exact trigger beyond the alley itself, so go to the Kolt & Associates alley, bowl a complete game, and watch for the pop at the end of it. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague, so this one is about a partnership moment — likely a story or side-strand beat where a partnership pays off publicly. Play the partner and stranger strands through and it should arrive on its own; the official description does not pin down the trigger, so do not grind for it — let the story bring it. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — this one is about a choice, made one way or the other. It is most likely tied to a story decision point, so when the game offers you a real choice, pick one and see it through; the trophy marks the decision itself, not the outcome. The official description does not name the choice, so do not force it — play the story and let the decision come. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The title gives it away: something that takes a second try. Missable — it is most likely tied to a mission or event that must be attempted twice, so if a story or side moment fails or goes wrong the first time, go back and do it again instead of reloading an old save to erase the failure. The official description does not name the trigger, so treat a failed first attempt as progress, not a loss. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague, and the title suggests a surprise — most likely a random world event or a strange encounter out in Leonida. Do not grind for it: keep playing, explore odd corners of the map, and take the strange encounters as they come. The official description does not pin down the trigger, so this is a patience trophy. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by — hit them with a melee weapon while driving past, knocking them down from the vehicle. Missable: set it up on purpose. Find a quiet road with pedestrians or enemies on foot, build a little speed, and swing as you pass — timing the hit is the skill, so make several passes and keep your speed low enough to aim. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — convert dirty money into clean cash, a little at a time, until the total hits a quarter of a million. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so keep laundering your takings through contacts as you earn them instead of sitting on a pile. The counter tracks lifetime laundered earnings. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the $250,000 target.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything the shops sell, all counting toward one total. This finishes itself if you shop normally through the game, but if you reach the endgame short, buy the big-ticket items you have been putting off: weapons, outfits and vehicle upgrades add up fast. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the $100,000 target.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — every garage the game sells, 8 of them per the roadmap count. Garages cost serious money, so save this for the late game when cash is flowing from laundering and heists, then buy them one by one until the last deed pops the trophy. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — add ten different vehicles you own into the app. As you buy or collect vehicles through the game, register each one in the app rather than leaving it in a garage unregistered; ten registrations is all it takes. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 10-vehicle target.
trophies.name: On the Spot
